utterances.cp1.guide: Take Elevator 1 to street level. Exit 2 is just outside.
utterances.cp1.board: At Exit 2, look at the notice board nearby. Look for the Chinese name of Taipei City Hospital, Renai Branch.
utterances.cp2.cross: Wait for the green pedestrian signal, then cross Fuxing South Road.
utterances.cp2.after: Now that you have crossed, turn right.
utterances.cp2.along: Continue straight along Fuxing South Road.
utterances.cp2.bike: Bicycles use this sidewalk too. Stay on the inner side.
utterances.cp2.water: There is a FamilyMart along the way if you need water. Take your time.
utterances.cp3.cross: Wait for the green pedestrian signal, then cross Renai Road.
utterances.cp3.after: After crossing, turn left. The hospital is on this side.
utterances.cp4.driveway: The driveway with the red Chinese characters for Emergency and the letter P is for vehicles. The lobby entrance is a little farther ahead.
utterances.ask.entrance: Does the sign above the door show the Chinese characters for Emergency? For outpatient visits, use the automatic glass doors to the lobby.
utterances.cp5.lobby: The row of automatic glass doors is the lobby entrance.
utterances.recover.er: That is the emergency driveway. The lobby entrance is a little farther ahead.
utterances.recover.daan.a: This road leads to Da'an Road. Let us turn around.
utterances.recover.daan.b: Follow the hospital wall back until you see the automatic glass doors.
utterances.recover.canopy: The green-roofed corridor is a side passage. Turn left toward Renai Road. The lobby entrance is ahead.
utterances.arrived: This is the hospital entrance. The service desk is on your left inside. They can help you with the next step.
utterances.reanchor: What can you see nearby? Just tell me.
utterances.photo.remind: Photograph the sign only. Keep faces, number plates, and patient information out of the picture. Google will read the photo. Nightingale does not save the original image.
utterances.photo.wait: Let me take a look at this photo.
